name: AgentSearch
description: Web search, page extract (URL to clean markdown) and JavaScript page rendering for AI agents. Free web search works with no key or wallet (up to 25 searches/day per IP, subject to shared daily capacity). Extract and render (and search, if opted in) are paid per call ($0.005 USDC on Base via x402) through the Pocket Network Agentic Portal, or point it at a self-hosted AgentSearch-compatible API. Also includes the free AgentSearch Review Board lookup/submit tools.

AGENTSEARCH_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Optional. Private key of a dedicated wallet holding USDC on Base; enables paid extract/render via the Pocket Network Agentic Portal. Without it, search uses the free tier.

AGENTSEARCH_MODE.description: Optional. Set to 'paid' (with a wallet key) to also pay per call for search instead of using the free tier.

AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of your own self-hosted AgentSearch-compatible API; takes precedence and no payment is made.
